bounded_chain.stage: registered concrete source and protection implementation
bounded_chain.observation: Actual module context installs ArmorApiaristHelper and registers capability default ArmorApiarist.INSTANCE; item registry constructs four equipment-slot armor items. Item capability returns default implementation; protectEntity unconditionallytrue, ignoring cause/doProtect and doing no durability/energy payment. Helper supports legacy item-interface or capability, skips empty stacks, queries cause=effect UID and doProtect=true. It counts entity.getEquipmentAndArmor(), not a hardcoded four armor-slot scan. Native iterable/third-party capabilities unexpanded, no universal item count/inventory exploit assertion.

AlleleEffects constructs Aggressive and harmful potion effects, then registerAlleles registers EFFECT chromosome. Read SINISTER/FIENDISH setAlleles selects aggressive; TROPICAL branch selects miasmic. These are actual source template methods, not proof whole breeding/natural acquisition. TileBeeHousingBase.updateServerSide calls canWork then doWork. canWork computes queen/error/flower state and synchronizes active state; doWork chooses princess breeding or queenWorkTick. Nonnull queenWorkTick calls queen.doEffect before production throttle. Source bootstrap/tile ticker factory/module enablement and complete world setup remain external to bounded screen.

Bee.doEffect validates storage then runs active effect; inactive effect only if both combinable. Both studied effects are noncombinable, so no second independent effect credit. Throttled implementation reuses any EffectData instance or creates one integer slot, skips increment if requiresWorkingQueen and housing errors, otherwise increments and resets on configured threshold. Aggressive threshold40/no working flag, potion threshold configured/requiresWorking=true; current housing work gate still applies at caller. These are call counts, not independently proven wall-clock ticks or full save/load policy.

bounded_chain.stage: target eligibility and source-side partial/full rejection
bounded_chain.observation: Actual AABB derives genome territory times housing modifier with scaled offset; getBounding does not call clamped getModifiedArea. Enumerates EntityLivingBase, no explicit target owner/Boss/alive/line-of-sight predicate in these methods. Aggressive starts damage4, subtracts protective count, skips attack when <=0, else requests attackEntityFrom without checking result. Potion first random chance, then for harmful effect count>=4 skips; counts3/2/1 shorten newly requested duration to1/4,1/2,3/4. Beneficial potion skips IMob and never queries armor. addPotionEffect result/final native admission unexpanded. Full protection prevents these producer calls, not all sources/effects on the target.

Client tile checks canDoBeeFX and interval4; canDoBeeFX tests local not-paused and active, doBeeFX calls current queen.doFX. Bee FX selection is independent of target protection/chance/result. Potion FX randomly delegates to generic bee FX or requests colored potion particles at housing position; no target success/refusal list. Base effect requests hive FX using flowers. These source activity cues are not target immunity receipts. No custom lasting target immunity state is established: every eligible source pulse rechecks equipment. Removing gear does not remove previously admitted native potion; ordinary duration/hidden-state cleanup belongs engine and is unexpanded.
